exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign under an interior independent product law, write v_S=product_i_in_S 4p_i(1-p_i), c_S=fhat(S)/sqrt(v_S), P(S)=v_S*c_S^2, E=sum_nonempty P(S)ln(v_S/P(S)), Delta=sum_nonempty (|S|-1)P(S), R=sum_|S|>=3 (|S|-2)P(S). For occupied nonempty S let t=|c_S|, and choose the unique j>=0 with 1/2<u=2^j*t<=1; set z=(1-u)/(1+u). For every integer N>=0 let L_N(z)=2sum_k=0..N-1 z^(2k+1)/(2k+1) and E_N=2sum_nonempty P(S)[j_S*ln2+L_N(z_S)]. Then E_N<=E_(N+1)<=E and 0<=E-E_N<=(11Delta-7R)/(2(2N+1)9^N). At zero deficit both are0. Dyadic normalized occupied coefficients give exact E_N=E even at N=0, including the actual flat bent tensor. The exact dyadic-scale terms are retained; no fixed global polynomial/cell count, independent Boolean reset, universal bound on E_N, or full FEI conclusion is asserted.
